correctness.rationale: For three independent isotropic oriented normals to great circles, Girard’s excess yields exactly A_sigma=π/2+σ1σ2t1+σ2σ3t2+σ3σ1t3 with t_i=asin(dot pair), so the cell area range R=2 max_(i<j)(|t_i|+|t_j|). The angular Gram density g(t)=prod cos(t_i)/(4π sqrt(1-sum sin²t_i+2 prod sin t_i)) has sign-symmetrization 4π gbar=1+(sum_(i<j)t_i²t_j²)/2+O(||t||^6). Independently expanded this density symbolically, verifying absence of quadratic terms, an odd cubic -t1t2t3 which integrates to zero, and quartic coefficient 1/2. Independently integrated over B=max pair |u_i|+|u_j|<1 to get vol(B)=2 and integral sum u_i²u_j²=7/120. Scaling t=(ε/2)u yields ε³/(16π)+7 ε^7/(122880π)+O(ε^9), without ε^4,ε^5,ε^6,ε^8 terms. Uniform density convergence on compact B proves total-variation uniform marked limit; gauge homogeneity gives Beta(3,1) range. Valid as ε↓0, not a global distribution.
